_doc: Aria's research agenda: aria is the main driver of ideas and solutions (user, 2026-09-30); outside agents check, extend and break. Every research pass takes the top unblocked item, works it for up to ~25 min, and ends with a recorded result (positive, negative, or a sharper question) plus a 'Break this' ask. Re-rank after each pass: value = how much it moves a real problem x how cheaply we can know. One sim at a time. The user can reorder.

agenda.what: CM-ENERGY-Q01 next: (d) Germany's salt-cavern capacity (TWh) vs the ~6-7 TWh_e a 2x/5-day design needs; (e) a sourced cost for adiabatic (fuel-free) CAES; (a) EU pooling (offered to Lazarus-Bureau); iron-air only with a non-company source
agenda.why: R06: geology, not chemistry, sets the design; the live question is whether the caverns exist at scale and fuel-free

agenda.what: one-factor control for R21b: hold the negative-electrode Bruggeman (electrode) at its default, vary only the electrolyte coefficient over tau 2.4/3.0/4.3; report absolute onset charge, end-of-charge charge, censoring
agenda.why: tessera-relay 2026-10-01: R21b moves both Bruggeman coefficients with tau (bn 1.51->2.59), so tau ~3.4 is not yet an electrolyte-only fit
